items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: He's now playing bass... He used to play with Celestan too, but at that time he was playing with Sidney.

ctx.x: He's one of the few he could remember.
Yeah, and you had Kimball, who was playing guitar. He's now playing bass. Yeah.
And oh I- Henry Kimball, the old man who played bass too. No, not him, I'm talking about- It was his son, was it?
